query:
SELECT
            (SELECT MIN(day) FROM guest_activity) AS since,
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email) FROM guest_activity
             WHERE day > CURRENT_DATE - 30)::INT AS "guest_count!",
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email) FROM guest_activity
             WHERE jwt_entry AND day > CURRENT_DATE - 30)::INT AS "guest_jwt_count!",
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT workspace_id) FROM guest_activity
             WHERE day > CURRENT_DATE - 30)::INT AS "guest_workspace_count!",
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.workspace_id) FROM app a JOIN workspace w ON w.id = a.workspace_id
             WHERE a.policy->>'execution_mode' = 'guest' AND NOT w.deleted)::INT AS "guest_enabled_workspace_count!",
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace WHERE NOT deleted)::INT AS "workspace_count!"
